stock.description: Golden Faith Group Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding enterprise with a primary focus on furnishing electrical and mechanical (E&M) engineering services throughout Hong Kong. The company's expertise covers a wide array of engineering solutions, including the implementation of electrical and extra-low voltage (ELV) systems, alongside ventilation and air-conditioning installations. Furthermore, it offers integrated services for the management, installation, supervision, and testing of these electrical and ELV systems. Beyond its core engineering operations, Golden Faith is also engaged in property investment. It serves both public and private sector clients, undertaking projects for diverse building types such as residential and commercial complexes, institutional buildings, government facilities, hotels, and hospitals. Founded in 1987, its corporate headquarters are located in Causeway Bay, Hong Kong.
